integrity: The sign correction is a universal 3x3 determinant identity and is not inferred from numerical eigenvalues.
The model-specific witness, equilibrium residuals, Jacobian, and Hurwitz inequalities are replayed with exact rational arithmetic by the bundled verifier.
Originality checks used the exact arXiv identifier, DOI, title, coefficient aliases, implication form, and witness parameters in published-finding corpus and web searches.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the analytic characteristic-polynomial, Routh-Hurwitz, and downstream Cardano/Shilnikov spectral formulas as written; it does not prove absence of the paper's numerically reported homoclinic trajectories.
The exact witness is a constructive positive parameter point in the dimensionless model, not a calibrated ecological parameter set.
The publisher supplement was not separately compared line-by-line; the inspected arXiv v2 contains the supplement and the journal landing page confirms the published work and DOI.
title: A sign-corrected stability polynomial for the intraguild-predation model
